events.text: Klemzig renamed Gaza during anti-German sentiment in WWI.

evidence.quote: In 1917 Klemzig was renamed Gaza

events.text: Klemzig name reinstated under South Australia Nomenclature Act 1935.

evidence.quote: Klemzig was re-instated as the suburb name with the enactment of the South Australia Nomenclature Act of 1935 on 12 December 1935

undated_mentions: Residents petitioned the South Australian Government to reinstate the name Gaza during World War II; requests were denied.
